question: Matching the pair: Which option correctly lists the Indian players named in the Team of the Tournament for the ICC Under-19 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2026?

options.text: Henil Patel - Khilan A. Patel, Kanishk Chouhan
Vaibhav Suryavanshi, Kanishk Chouhan, Henil Patel
Vaibhav Suryavanshi, Aaron George, Kanishk Chouhan
Ayush Mhatre, Abhigyan Kundu, Henil Patel

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaibhav Suryavanshi, Kanishk Chouhan, Henil Patel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• Three Indian players were selected in the Team of the Tournament for the ICC Under-19 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Vaibhav Suryavanshi was the leading run-scorer of the tournament with 439 runs.
 
• Kanishk Chouhan played a key role as a consistent top-order batsman.
 
• Henil Patel made significant contributions with the ball during crucial matches.
 
• The Team of the Tournament represents the best performers across all participating teams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Team of the Tournament**__ is an honorary selection recognizing outstanding individual performances throughout the competition.
 
• __**Selection Criteria**__ generally includes runs scored, wickets taken, consistency, and match-winning impact.
 
• __**All-Round Contribution**__ refers to a player’s ability to influence matches through batting, bowling, or fielding.
 
• __**ICC Under-19 World Cup**__ serves as a talent pipeline for future international cricketers.
